baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled denial at words 1 and 5 advances through the collective, the servant, the madness label, and the final passive rebuke.
baseline_models.mechanism: A communal refusal becomes a personal verdict: the group attributes falsehood to the servant, circulates a diagnosis that covers his reason, and thereby converts an epistemic dispute into permission for vocal and social coercion.

activation_trace.role: Attributing falsehood supplies the move from rejecting content to discrediting its bearer.
The human collective gives the verdict a social body and coercive reach.
A saying that circulates among people turns the diagnosis into a public instrument.
The image of reason being covered supplies the diagnosis while concealing the underlying truth dispute.
Forceful vocal restraint converts the spoken label into attempted stoppage or expulsion.

changed_reading.before: Noah's people rejected him, called him mad, and rebuked him.
changed_reading.after: The verse exposes an escalation in which collective denial becomes public diagnosis and then coercive silencing.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The narrator's designation of the denied figure as 'Our servant' stands against the community's designation of him as mad.
baseline_models.mechanism: Two authorities name the same person. The divine relation marks obedient service, while the collective turns its own belief into a diagnosis of veiled reason; the conflict is therefore also over whose naming fixes reality.

activation_trace.role: Obedient and humbled service supplies the narrator's relational identity for the rejected person.
The collective supplies the rival social authority that issues the diagnosis.
Speech as belief or position makes the label a communal account of reality, not a stray insult.
Covered reason supplies the community's counter-identity and its claim to epistemic superiority.

changed_reading.before: The verse alternates a respectful narrator's title with a hostile accusation.
changed_reading.after: The verse stages a jurisdictional conflict between divine relation and collective diagnosis over who may truthfully name the servant.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The temporal marker at word 2 links the Noah community to an implied later audience, while denial is repeated twice inside the verse.
baseline_models.mechanism: Temporal precedence makes the episode a reusable precedent. The first denial names the group's posture and the second targets the servant, so the doubled root compresses a recurring historical pattern into a single social sequence.

activation_trace.role: Temporal advance and precedence connect this denial to those positioned after it.
Repeated attribution of falsehood supplies the reproducible action linking group posture to personal attack.
A bounded people supplies the historical carrier of a pattern that can recur in another collective.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports an earlier people's rejection.
changed_reading.after: The earlier people become a precedent-loop: denial reproduces itself from collective posture to targeted silencing and remains available to later groups.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding sequence presents rupture, sight, a visible sign, bodily turning-away, a deception label, and renewed denial. Against that sequence, the focus label of madness reads as a second displacement tactic: instability is relocated from the challenged communal account of what was seen onto the messenger's mind.

activation_trace.role: Covered reason anchors the focus accusation as a diagnosis of the messenger.
A visible splitting supplies the rupture that the later counter-label must rhetorically contain.
Eye-seeing establishes that the rejection follows perception rather than simple absence of evidence.
The manifest mark gives the perceived event evidentiary status before it is relabeled.
Turning the side away supplies the embodied refusal between seeing and speaking.
Diversion and deception supply the first counter-label that neutralizes a seen sign.
Renewed attribution of falsehood closes the see-turn-label sequence and links it to the focus's doubled denial.

structural_cues: 54:1-3 orders rupture, sight, sign, turning, counter-label, and denial immediately before the Noah unit.
The focus repeats the same speech-to-label-to-denial logic but changes the label's object from an event to a person.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the visible rupture, perception, turning, deception label, and repeated denial; I infer that 'madman' performs the same displacement by projecting instability onto the servant. A live alternative is that 'magic' and 'madness' are merely parallel insults without a shared projection mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The madness label is one hostile claim among several.
changed_reading.after: The madness label is the person-directed form of a prior strategy: perceive a disruptive sign, turn away, and relocate the disruption into a discrediting diagnosis.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same restraint root changes direction and grammatical packaging. In the focus, rebuke bears passively upon the servant; in 54:4, transmitted reports contain a deterrent for the hearers. Human restraint suppresses warning, while narrated warning returns as restraint upon the suppressors.

activation_trace.role: Forceful vocal restraint supplies the pressure directed against the servant.
A report arriving and being conveyed supplies the medium through which restraint returns to the audience.
Deterring rebuke is now contained in the report and functionally redirected toward would-be rejecters.

structural_cues: The focus uses a passive verb for the servant's being rebuked, whereas 54:4 uses a derived noun for deterrence contained in reports.
54:4 announces report-borne restraint before 54:9 supplies one such report and ends with the same root.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact-root recurrence, changed grammatical form, and the report container; I infer a reversal from silencing the warner to warning that restrains the silencers. The weaker alternative is lexical cohesion without deliberate directional reversal.

changed_reading.before: The final passive records the successful intimidation of Noah.
changed_reading.after: The final passive is caught in a reversal: the attempt to silence warning becomes report material whose own force is to restrain later hearers.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context describes accurate wisdom that reaches its end-point, then questions what warnings can avail. This separates completeness of message from efficacy in the hearer and reverses the community's diagnosis: the blockage need not lie in the servant's reason or delivery.

activation_trace.role: Covered reason supplies the community's proposed location of failure.
Knowledge that hits rightly supplies a counter-description of the discourse's cognitive quality.
Arrival at the limit marks the message as having reached rather than stalled in transmission.
Sufficiency frames the explicit question of why warning nevertheless fails to benefit.
Fear-arousing notice supplies the intended awakening that does not guarantee uptake.

structural_cues: 54:5 coordinates completed wisdom with a negative question about the warnings' efficacy.
The focus's madness label follows this frame of sound message but failed benefit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies right knowledge, arrival, sufficiency, warning, and the focus diagnosis; I assign failed uptake to the receivers rather than defective delivery. A live alternative is that 54:5 evaluates revelation generally and does not specifically reverse Noah's opponents.

changed_reading.before: The community alleges that the servant's mind makes his warning defective.
changed_reading.after: The context relocates the defect: wisdom can arrive fully while warning still fails to benefit, making the madness label a receiver's counter-diagnosis.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus community uses rebuke to control the servant's voice and movement. The eschatological frame reverses both powers: turning away is authorized, another caller draws the rejecters in haste and submission, and their own speech now registers distress rather than governing the messenger.

activation_trace.role: Vocal expulsion anchors the community's attempted control of the servant's movement and speech.
Turning away becomes an authorized act toward the rejecters rather than a defeat imposed by them.
A call that inclines by speech supplies the voice the rejecters cannot silence or evade.
Hastening forward reverses the earlier ability to stop and drive away the servant.
Submission supplies the changed power relation under the later call.
Their utterance remains, but its function changes from diagnosing another to confessing their own hard situation.

structural_cues: 54:6-8 frames a caller, compelled approach, and rejecters' speech immediately before the Noah report.
The focus ends with forced withdrawal, while the frame depicts forced approach.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies turning, call, haste, submission, and changed speaker-content; I infer a reversal of who controls voice and movement. The alternative is a broad eschatological contrast with no specific answer to Noah's rebuke.

changed_reading.before: The people appear able to end the servant's intervention by rebuking him.
changed_reading.after: Their local control is provisional: authorized withdrawal and an irresistible call reverse who may direct bodies, voices, and attention.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next verse interprets the passive rebuke as being overpowered but refuses to let overpowering be terminal. The servant converts silencing into a call, names the asymmetry, and requests that the wronged party be vindicated.

activation_trace.role: Forceful restraint supplies the social pressure from which the appeal begins.
Calling by speech converts suppressed public address into direct appeal.
Conquering force names the real social condition behind the focus's passive rebuke.
Vindication of the wronged supplies the requested reversal of that overpowering.

structural_cues: 54:10 begins with a consequence marker directly after the focus's final passive.
The sequence moves from being acted upon, to naming defeat, to requesting reversal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rebuke, consequential calling, overpowering, and vindication; I take 54:10 as an unpacking and redirection of the focus's final passive. The alternative is that overpowering summarizes a longer conflict rather than specifically glossing the rebuke.

changed_reading.before: Being rebuked closes the servant's speech and marks defeat.
changed_reading.after: Being rebuked is a hinge: imposed silence becomes appeal, defeat is named, and naming it opens a demand for redress.

context_deltas.mechanism: After social pressure attempts to close the servant's speech and place, the response opens above and below, sends water pouring, makes streams meet, carries the denied person, watches over him, and renders recompense. Agency expands from a coercive crowd to a coordinated material field.

activation_trace.role: Restraint and expulsion supply the social closure that the material sequence answers.
The opening of what was closed reverses the crowd's attempt to close down the servant's intervention.
Uninterrupted pouring gives material force to the release initiated by opening.
Wide splitting and emission extends the answer through the ground as well as the sky.
Two counterparts meeting coordinates separate releases into one effective event.
Bearing the visible load changes the servant from an expelled body into a carried one.
Watchful preservation supplies protective oversight against the crowd's hostile surveillance.
Answering an act with its recompense makes the material reversal a response rather than scenery.
Covering the truth identifies the protected person by the rejection enacted against him.

structural_cues: 54:10-14 forms an appeal-and-response chain: call, opening, bursting, meeting, carrying, oversight, recompense.
The focus's final passive narrows agency around a pressured servant; the response distributes agency across sky, earth, water, vessel, and watch.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies social restraint followed by openings, flows, convergence, carriage, watch, and recompense; I infer a closure-to-opening and expulsion-to-carriage answer. The live alternative is a purely narrative consequence without formal inversion of the focus's social mechanics.

changed_reading.before: The servant is a socially isolated object of collective force.
changed_reading.after: His isolation triggers an agency-scale reversal: the material world opens and coordinates to carry the one whom the community tried to close out.

context_deltas.mechanism: The community's circulated madness label attempts to determine how the servant will be socially retained. The later frame instead leaves a manifest sign and repeats an invitation to remember through accessible recitation, shifting durability from hostile saying to preserved trace.

activation_trace.role: A saying spread among people anchors the community's attempt to control public memory.
Covering and concealment make the label an attempted veil over the servant's intelligibility.
Leaving a residue supplies the durable counter-record to the hostile saying.
A manifest mark specifies what is preserved for later recognition.
A reminder gives the residual sign an active function in future memory.
Openness and ease after difficulty counter the claim that the message is cognitively sealed off.
Recitation supplies the repeatable transmission channel through which the event outlasts its hostile label.
Repeated retrieval after forgetfulness makes remembrance the audience's unresolved task.

structural_cues: 54:15 and 54:17 repeat the same remembrance question around the warning in 54:16.
The focus contains a public saying; the close of the unit emphasizes what is left, recited, and recalled.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies circulated speech, concealment, a left sign, repeated remembrance, ease, and recitation; I infer a contest over which account endures. The alternative is that the remembrance refrain exhorts the audience without directly answering the madness label.

changed_reading.before: The community's label defines the servant within its immediate social world.
changed_reading.after: The label loses the durability contest: a preserved sign and repeatable recitation carry the servant's warning into later memory.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the ordinary force of the doubled root here is denial, while failed charge, vanished yield, and a runner stopping are branch-distant images. It remains anchored in both focus occurrences and the final coercive stop, and context later supplies arrival and residue. Downstream prose should present it only as a durability-and-motion analogy, never as an alternate lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The doubled denial and final passive rebuke can carry an analogical wager over whether the servant's advance can be made to fail, stop, or leave no yield.

activation_trace.role: A charge that fails to carry through supplies the mission-as-advance analogy behind the people's verdict.
Yield that disappears instead of lasting makes endurance part of the attempted negation.
A runner that advances and then stops supplies a kinetic image for arresting the servant's course.
Forceful restraint supplies the social action intended to make the predicted stopping real.
Arrival at the goal resists the attempted verdict that the mission will stall.
A residue left behind overturns the attempted prediction of disappearance without yield.

changed_reading.before: They pronounce the servant false and forcefully reject him.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, their denial also behaves like a wager that his mission can be stopped and made non-durable, a wager contradicted by arrival and preserved residue.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation uses the packet's non-dominant mapping from the speech root to the smallness-and-agitation inventory, so it is form-distant and must not replace the normal meaning 'they said.' It remains anchored in the focus utterance immediately followed by rebuke and in repeated contextual utterances. Downstream prose should qualify it as an acoustic and social-force analogy licensed by the split mapping.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The construction 'they said ... and he was rebuked' permits the utterance to be heard not only as content but as the force that unsettles and dislodges its target.

activation_trace.role: Agitated movement and lack of stability supply an analogical effect for the community's utterance on the servant's social place.
Vocal rebuke makes the displacement effect explicit at the end of the focus construction.
A repeated contextual utterance extends the analogy from one insult to a recurrent destabilizing speech practice.
Bodily trembling or agitation returns when the speakers themselves confront the hard day, reversing the projected instability.

changed_reading.before: The saying reports a hostile diagnosis that precedes a separate act of rebuke.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the saying is itself part of the rebuking force: public speech agitates and dislodges the servant before instability returns to the speakers.

strongest_changes: The exact-root reversal of restraint turns the servant's silencing into report-borne deterrence for later hearers.
The visible-sign sequence makes the madness label a person-directed displacement strategy rather than an isolated insult.
The next verse converts passive defeat into appeal and vindication, after which material opening, carriage, and watch reverse social closure.
The preserved sign and remembrance refrain move durability from the crowd's circulated diagnosis to the servant's transmitted warning.
summary.what_was_special: The focus is unusually compressed around rival naming and directional reversals: collective speech covers reason and forces withdrawal, while the surrounding unit redirects the same mechanics through deterrent report, irresistible call, vindicating appeal, material opening, and preserved memory. The split non-dominant speech mapping also preserves a contained acoustic reading in which utterance itself destabilizes.
remaining_uncertainties: The final passive leaves the immediate agent and exact mode of rebuke unstated.
The link between the magic label and the madness label as one projection mechanism is abductive rather than grammatical.
The closure-to-opening and failed-mission readings are material analogies, not alternate lexical parses.
The non-dominant speech-to-agitation mapping should remain explicitly exploratory.
